# OTHER

> Every page of the OTHER module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Other](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other): The Other calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Support: delete records by correlation ID](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-delete): Internal troubleshooting operation on the claim service that deletes records by correlationid and action; not part of the business transaction flows.
- [NHCX: report a request it could not deliver](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-error): Where the exchange tells a sender that a request could not be delivered after five attempts. Received by every participant under its registered address....
- [Patient app: acknowledge a notification subscription](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-notification-on-subscribe): BSP-side subscription acknowledgement; the same name denotes the callback where NHCX pushes claim-event notifications for a subscribed ABHA ID.
- [Patient app: subscribe an ABHA number to notifications](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-notification-subscribe): A Beneficiary Service Provider (PHR app) subscribes an ABHA ID to notification topics; NHCX persists it synchronously, Last-Linked-Wins per ABHA ID.
- [Recipient: answer a status check](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-on-status): The answer to a status request, delivered to the sender that asked. The x-hcx-status in the protected header says where the message you asked about got to....
- [Participant receives an error report](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-webhook-v1-error): Hosted by every participant. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/error, with the headers and the sealed payload the...
- [Sender receives the status answer](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-webhook-v1-on-status): Hosted by every participant that sends /v1/status. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/on_status, with the headers...
- [Other errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-92/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/errors): What Other returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
